forms_without_procedure.stage: The completion step of a recall procedure of the medicines regulator (HLT-MED-017): not built; the form waits in the library (plan step I4).

forms_without_procedure.title: Register a medical device
forms_without_procedure.stage: A device registration procedure of the medicines regulator on the product register (assessment, then a decision under the approved permit mapping): not built; the form waits in the library (plan step I4).

forms_without_procedure.title: Report a medical device incident
forms_without_procedure.stage: A device incident intake of the medicines regulator that opens an investigation of the device, possibly leading to a review (HLT-MED-009) or a recall (HLT-MED-017): not built; the form waits in the library (plan step I4).

forms_without_procedure.title: Ask for a medicines regulatory decision to be reconsidered
forms_without_procedure.stage: A reconsideration or appeal procedure of the medicines regulator or the body the law names (an appeal to a court is filed with the court and worked only by the judiciary): not built; the form waits in the library (plan step I4).

forms_without_procedure.title: Check a medicine's or device's authorisation
forms_without_procedure.stage: A public product check and a product-status exchange service of the medicines regulator, answered from the product register; no case is opened. Not built: the form waits in the library (plan step I4).

forms_without_procedure.title: Submit an aggregate public-health return
forms_without_procedure.stage: A public-health aggregate return of the receiving authority, kept like the capacity returns (lib/health/register.ts: versioned, always marked reported, corrections as new versions): the programme returns are not built; the form waits in the library (plan step I4).
